title: Enveda raises $311 million to test nature-derived drugs
teaser: Enveda has raised $311 million to move drugs discovered in plants and microbes toward human trials. Founded in 2019 by Vishva Kolluru, the company uses AI and other methods to speed up drug discovery without synthesizing every compound from scratch. Its current candidates target severe skin diseases and the challenge of maintaining weight loss after stopping GLP-1 drugs.
